candidates.evidence: Real read_file calls: 5 MiB p50 48.111 ms / p95 61.758; 25 MiB p50 217.989 / p95 245.792. Isolated existing parser costs 14.725 / 93.611 ms p50 respectively. Frequent file/media path; localized constant-allocation parsing possible; preserve metadata, content and error contracts.

Validation and admission each load all HarnessMessage columns, but consume only role/id. Disposable SQLite: 200 messages, 50 MiB total body materialization, 2 reads p50 51.037 ms / p95 51.387. User-visible edit admission; moderate session-scope/order/concurrency risk.

Real local Git scout: 5 repositories produce 28 runtime calls, including 10 HEAD/branch commands; p50 43.428 ms / p95 53.681. Batch only the two fixed metadata reads; strong remote round-trip gain but lower frequency and framing/error tests needed.

ChatController.buildSnapshot clones/freezes sessions, todos, lineage and gates on every publish including text deltas. Message parts already structurally shared. Device profiling required; larger ownership/invalidation scope.
HarnessMarkdown parses/sanitizes/reconstructs complete growing document. Already coalesced at 50 ms; incremental parsing risks reference-link correctness. Browser profiling required.
collectDescendantSessionIds scans all sessions repeatedly until ancestry resolves, used by both clients. Typical shallow trees may be cheap; replacement must preserve event ordering.
Real 64 KiB writes p50 5.635 ms including chmod-only p50 1.281 ms. Moving mode into tar alone would change umask semantics, so risk outweighs the narrower benefit.
